name: Explore sample growth overview and enquiries
description: Demo shows clearly marked example information with no claim of live client data.
steps: Open the app without signing in
Confirm the dashboard greets Dr Ikram Wazir and shows DEMO WORKSPACE and a personalised demo disclaimer
Check four clinic metrics, enquiry trend, recent activity and website concept card
expected: Dr Ikram Wazir appears in the labelled sample dashboard; sample metric cards, clinic activity and website concept are visible; sample enquiries remain browseable.

name: Demo cannot write client records
description: Actions in sample mode must request authentication and not mutate sample data.
steps: Open the unsigned demo on a mobile screen
Confirm Dr Ikram Wazir is visible with sample metrics and the bottom mobile navigation
expected: Mobile design shows the clinic information without overflow, and attempt to add an enquiry is blocked with the read-only sample mode message.

name: Manage a private business profile and enquiry
description: Authenticated workspace saves a real business profile and enquiry status.
steps: From Overview select Set up your business and save a business name, industry and city
Open Enquiries and add a named test enquiry with a service
Change its status to Booked and refresh the page
expected: The saved business profile and enquiry with Booked status remain visible after refreshing.

name: Request content and upload a clinic photo
covers: saved request and image after reload
description: Signed-in client can submit a growth task and securely store a supported image.
steps: Open Content studio and request a social content task with a title
Open Media library and upload a JPG or PNG under 3MB
expected: The request remains in the list with Requested status and the uploaded image remains visible in the library.

name: Reject invalid enquiry and large image
covers: upload file type and size guard
description: Empty required fields and unsupported images must be rejected.
steps: Open Add enquiry and try to save without a name or service
In Media library choose a non-image file or image larger than 3 MB
expected: Enquiry form blocks empty required fields; media uploader reports acceptable image formats and size limits.
